answer: The applicant commits to a hash of a short tandem repeat profile, never the raw DNA, and the commitment is checked against a registry of hashes, so one genome can back exactly one identity. A farm needs a thousand distinct genomes with consenting donors, while one honest agent commits once and the hash reveals nothing about its biology. The nadir of the design is public, the opal of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the oasis of honest work is what finally pays.
